seoTitle: Max-Morrys Agency — Product, AI, Technology & Brand
seoDescription: We build the digital products, AI systems and brand experiences businesses need to move forward. The Product, AI, Technology & Brand practice of MY ONOMA, from Dakar.

hero.subtitle: Product strategy, engineering, AI systems and brand experiences. We work on projects where product, technology and business have to work together.

whoWeHelp.subtitle: We don't take on every project. We take on the ones where a product decision drives a technical decision, and the other way round.

whoWeHelp.notFor: We are not a fixed-price web shop, a communications agency, or a full-service agency. If your need is primarily growth, acquisition or revenue, we'll point you to the practice that owns it.

myOnoma.title: Max-Morrys Agency is the Product, AI, Technology & Brand practice of MY ONOMA.
myOnoma.body: MY ONOMA is a Digital Product & Growth Studio. It builds products and systems for clients, builds growth machines, and develops its own products.
myOnoma.legalNote: Engagements contracted under MY ONOMA are delivered by MY ONOMA SARL.
myOnoma.growBody: For Growth, Revenue & Operations engagements, we work within MY ONOMA alongside Cléa Growth Office. It is a sibling practice, not a subcontractor.
myOnoma.growDistinction: Max-Morrys Agency builds the systems. Cléa Growth Office builds and runs the growth machine.

items.q: How is this different from the Digital Presence offer?
items.a: Digital Presence is a productised offer for local businesses: website, Google listing, WhatsApp catalogue, regular publishing, at published prices. Max-Morrys Agency works on bespoke projects where product, technology and business are entangled. Two distinct offers, two distinct funnels.

No. Every engagement is scoped from a problem, a perimeter and a timeline. We work per project, on retainer, or in an advisory capacity. The form includes a budget range: it's there to check we're aligned before wasting your time.
Max-Morrys Agency is a commercial brand. Engagements contracted under MY ONOMA are delivered by MY ONOMA SARL, a Senegalese company based in Dakar.
Yes. The studio is based in Dakar and works remotely. Product and engineering don't depend on being on site; we align working rhythms with your time zone.

items.q: Do you use AI to build?
items.a: Yes — AI-assisted engineering, across code, tests and tooling. It speeds delivery up. It does not replace architecture trade-offs, review, or accountability for what ships.

Deliverables built for a client belong to that client, under the terms of their contract. Our methods, generic components and internal tooling remain ours. That boundary is explicit and written into our contracts.

meta.title: Max-Morrys Agency — projects we run together
meta.description: Rebuilds, platforms, automation, applied AI. Few projects at a time, framed before they are priced. No public rate card on this page: a conversation first, then a written scope.

steps.body: Forty-five minutes, no commitment. We look at whether the problem is worth the budget you have in mind.
